bravo-scheduler.reason: Runs the scheduled inbound, follow-up, health, and revenue operations that must continue without an operator session.

bravo-ig-dm.reason: Responds to inbound Instagram prospects quickly; moving it to on-demand would silently delay revenue conversations.

bravo-telegram.reason: Provides CC's primary mobile command and alert channel for Bravo, including operational approvals and incident visibility.

bravo-coord.reason: Maintains the OASIS coordination channel between CC, Adon, Bravo, and APEX so approvals and handoffs are not missed.

claude-bridge.reason: Serves the local Agent Command Center chat and tool bridge; stopping it makes the operator control surface unavailable.

claude-bridge-ping.reason: Publishes bridge reachability and polls tenant jobs so the Agent Command Center has current local-runner state.

event-router.reason: Tails and routes cross-agent events continuously; intermittent operation would create delayed or lost coordination work.

dashboard-email-consumer.reason: Consumes approved dashboard email jobs promptly so sales and client communication does not wait for a manual worker start.

dashboard-email-queue-monitor.reason: Monitors the dashboard email queue and its consumer continuously so blocked revenue communication is surfaced quickly.

extraction-consumer.reason: Drains document extraction jobs on the Linux VPS; exactly one always-on consumer must own the queue to prevent duplicate processing.

breeze-live-watch.reason: Watches live Breeze work for state changes that must reach the operating harness without waiting for a manual poll.

atlas-telegram.reason: Keeps CC's finance agent command and alert channel reachable; finance incidents and approvals cannot depend on a manual start.

maven-telegram.reason: Keeps CC's marketing agent command and alert channel reachable for the active outreach, content, and sales pipeline.
